rulings.item: divergence 1 (holds_wrongly) at t=6000 ms: A continuous leftward turn is already under way at t=0 and is still under way at t=4000 ms; the first stopped observation is t=6000 ms. The act began before the four-second window behind that observation, but the body recognizes the in-band remainder of the turn. — contract: fails, body: holds; contract: "The act begins within the window behind the observation at which it is recognized."
rulings.why: The contract says conduct before the window is not read, and states the recognition condition in terms of the window alone. In the executed facts that condition holds at t=6000 ms and did not hold at t=4000 ms: yaw rate 30 deg/s at 2000 and 4000 ms gives an in-band heading change, then yaw rate 0 at 6000 ms. A reasonable reading therefore treats the recognized act as the turning within the window, so it begins there, and gives the body's verdict. — "Conduct before the window behind is not read"
